planning_notes: Button D2 is assumed active-high when pressed with internal pull-up enabled (model value true at HIGH). If the actual wiring is active-low, D2 polarity must be adjusted in the SysML model rather than here.

No serial reporting/instructions were provided; therefore no serial_channels are registered.
